params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $candidates=@('C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods','C:\Users\Xxkan\Desktop\mhw-mods','C:\Users\Xxkan\Documents\mhw-mods','C:\Users\Xxkan\source\repos\mhw-mods','C:\Users\Xxkan\repos\mhw-mods','C:\Users\Xxkan\Projects\mhw-mods'); $repo=$null; foreach($p in $candidates){ if(Test-Path (Join-Path $p '.git')){ $u=& git -C $p remote get-url origin 2>$null; if($u -match 'fengie/mhw-mods'){ $repo=$p; break } } }; if(-not $repo){ $repo=Get-ChildItem 'C:\Users\Xxkan' -Directory -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'mhw-mods' -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName '.git')) } | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName }; if(-not $repo){ throw 'mhw-mods checkout not found' }; Write-Output ('REPO='+$repo); & git -C $repo fetch origin --prune; $branches=& git -C $repo for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/remotes/origin | Where-Object { $_ -ne 'origin/main' -and $_ -ne 'origin/HEAD' }; foreach($b in $branches){ $name=$b -replace '^origin/',''; & git -C $repo merge-base --is-ancestor $b origin/main; $ancestor=($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0); $cherry=@(& git -C $repo cherry origin/main $b); $plus=@($cherry | Where-Object { $_ -like '+ *' }).Count; $minus=@($cherry | Where-Object { $_ -like '- *' }).Count; Write-Output (('BRANCH={0}|ANCESTOR={1}|PLUS={2}|MINUS={3}') -f $name,$ancestor,$plus,$minus) }
